extensionDescription.message: Adds localized prompt tools to YouTube watch pages: use Standard or Advanced mode, copy transcript plus the selected AI prompt in one click, and edit your own prompts in Settings.

popup_lede.message: Choose how PromptTube appears on YouTube watch pages.

popup_mode_standard_help.message: Shows one simple summary prompt button. Edit that prompt in Settings.

popup_mode_advanced_help.message: Shows the full prompt selector with all available prompt templates.

options_lede.message: Edit the prompts shown in YouTube, add new ones, or reset back to the defaults.

options_section_copy.message: Each prompt needs a label and the instruction text to prepend before the transcript.

options_standard_prompt_note.message: The Summary prompt is used in Standard mode and cannot be removed.

options_standard_prompt_locked.message: The Summary prompt is used in Standard mode and cannot be removed.

options_storage_unavailable.message: Storage is unavailable in this browser context.

options_storage_local.message: Using local-only storage. Prompts will not sync between browsers.

options_storage_sync_generic.message: Using sync-backed storage. Prompt data should sync between signed-in browsers that support extension sync.

options_storage_sync_usage.message: Using sync-backed storage. Prompt data uses $1 of the sync quota (~100 KB total on Firefox).

options_status_load_saved_error.message: Could not load saved prompts. Showing defaults.

options_status_storage_unavailable.message: Storage API unavailable. Prompts were not saved.

options_status_add_one.message: Add at least one prompt before saving.

options_status_storage_only_page.message: Storage API unavailable. Defaults restored only on this page.

tip_manage_prompts.message: Tip: Use the PromptTube icon to manage prompts

no_transcript_found.message: No transcript found for this video

preset_summary_body.message:
Please summarise this YouTube transcript.
Give me:
- a concise summary
- the key takeaways
- the main conclusion in one short paragraph

preset_summary_analysis_body.message:
Please summarise and analyse this YouTube transcript.
Give me:
- a 6-10 bullet summary
- the main themes or arguments
- what matters most and why
- any notable strengths, weaknesses, or assumptions

preset_summary_actions_body.message:
Please summarise this YouTube transcript and extract next steps.
Give me:
- a concise summary
- key takeaways
- clear action items
- any decisions or follow-ups worth tracking

preset_summary_fact_check_body.message:
Please summarise this YouTube transcript and flag anything that should be fact-checked.
Give me:
- a concise summary
- the main claims made
- any statements that seem uncertain, exaggerated, or likely to need verification
- a short fact-check checklist of what to verify first
Then do the fact-checking and give me:
- a summary of what you found
- any claims that were confirmed, debunked, or remain uncertain after checking

preset_executive_brief_body.message:
Turn this YouTube transcript into an executive brief.
Give me:
- a short high-level overview
- the most important insights
- business or strategic implications
- the top risks or opportunities

preset_study_notes_body.message:
Convert this YouTube transcript into study notes.
Give me:
- a structured summary by topic
- important definitions or concepts
- likely exam or discussion questions
- a short recap I can review quickly later

preset_critique_opportunities_body.message:
Review this YouTube transcript critically.
Give me:
- a concise summary
- what is convincing or useful
- what is missing, weak, or questionable
- ideas, opportunities, or improvements inspired by it
